error.oracle: Frozen peak resource cap exceeded: fileDescriptors

findings: The attempt failed its predeclared finite FD cap; no time is credited as a passed steady stage. The existing frozen profile and failed receipt remain immutable.

Only one sample at 25 descriptors was retained before shutdown. Its immediately preceding sample was 23. The data neither demonstrate persistent descriptor growth nor identify a legitimate transient owner.
The controller records FD counts without target/category inventories. The process has exited, so the failed descriptor identities cannot now be recovered from /proc.

The zero Server gauges are from an asynchronous observer snapshot rather than an atomic snapshot with the procfs FD list. They cannot establish that no request or connection owned descriptors at the procfs sampling instant.
Zero final native source/session/operation/cursor/buffer/registry counters and Server gauges verify their tracked cleanup, but those counters are not an inventory of every runtime or OS descriptor.

The generic cap rule used a stable idle distribution to provide transient-load headroom. Because all three idle values were 23, it allowed only one descriptor above idle. The pinned specification does not mandate that particular statistical rule.

pinned_requirements.requirement: Freeze load, duration and finite resource thresholds before each run, record owners, roots, permits, threads, handles and RSS; retain failed or missing stages.
Section 8 requires the 30-minute steady state and stable resource plateau without linear growth. Section 6 separates TLS/socket/protocol/allocator/GC overhead from payload owner limits.

minimum_recovery: Preserve this exact failed attempt and its profile without widening them or crediting partial time. Leave the unrelated SQLite steady run unchanged.

Execute one bounded diagnostic under the existing load-slot authorization with the same product artifact, rate, concurrency, dataset and fault schedule. Observe actual FD target categories/identities and temporal changes while alive, including a drain/idle witness; record /proc list/readlink races explicitly.

Classify additional descriptors against owned sockets, runtime/inherited descriptors, attachment/staging files and database files/connections. Use that evidence and fixed concurrency/ownership limits to predeclare any prospective transient allowance, while retaining a separate stable-idle return requirement. Do not choose a new threshold from the failed count 25 alone or an arbitrary percentage.

Freeze a new independently reviewed profile with explicit derivation and provenance only after this explanation is supported; execute a fresh full 30-minute attempt under that profile. Existing validated unaffected evidence can remain cited rather than replayed.
limits: No diagnostic load, source mutation or threshold change was performed by this reviewer. The user-excluded 24-hour and 72-hour stages remain not executed.
